codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex round-1 surfaced 4 substantive corrections: (1) CR-1 fence tracking must store opener marker char + length, allow 0-3 leading spaces, require closer to use SAME marker with run length >= opener and ONLY trailing whitespace (no info string on closer); tilde fences must be protected too; unclosed fences must preserve all remaining lines. (2) CR-2 inclusive findDetailsClose alone is INSUFFICIENT — collectDetailsBody would double-count the same line as inlineRest AND closerHead; SUMMARY_LINE_RE doesn't match `<summary>X</summary>Y` (trailing-Y case); fix must strip </details> from inlineRest, skip closerHead push when openIndex===endIndex, and relax summary regex to capture inline body remainder. (3) CR-3 transform: translateY is the right minimal fix; needs live render verification on web/iOS/Android because nested RN Text inline-shift may not render consistently; do NOT substitute textAlignVertical (won't work for inline baseline shift); hardcoded fontSize:10 is acceptable, less scope-expanding than 0.75em derivation. (4) CR-4 add only markdown.footnoteTitle to all 10 translation files + _default.ts; do NOT expand to rich footnote modal i18n.
codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: Spec was substantially expanded based on codex round-1: §4 added a new CR-2-EXTENDED evidence section documenting the 3 cascading bugs codex caught; §8 expanded Must-Have list from 4 items (M5: inclusive scan only) to 4+4 items (M5 inclusive scan + M6 no-double-count + M7 inline-body-summary + M8 trailing-text out-of-scope); §9.1 implementation pseudo-code reflects fence marker char + length; §9.2 documents 3 coordinated changes (findDetailsClose callsite, collectDetailsBody same-line branch, SUMMARY_LINE_RE extension or extractDetailsSummary mutation); §10 ACs include AC-CR1-MISMATCHED-CLOSER-NOT-CLOSING (codex's `\`\`\`ts cannot close` directive) and AC-CR1-TILDE-FENCE-PROTECTED; §13 Out-of-Scope explicitly excludes 0.75em derivation and trailing-text-after-</details> case; §14 R5 documents the live-render-required risk for transform: translateY with explicit prohibition of textAlignVertical substitution.
